slots.note: optional Dante/AES67 card: 2x Ethernet (redundant) + 2 analog stereo line in / 2 line out (3.5mm)

notes:
Alta 4K series. In 1-2: multi-plug HDMI 1.4 / 3G-SDI (one active). HDMI loop-through on In 5 and In 8. Out 1-4 each multi-plug HDMI 2.0 + 12G-SDI (Out 3-4 also 12G-SFP; SFP cage carries 12G-SDI optical, module not specified). MVR = HDMI 1.4 + 3G-SDI mirrored. Control Ethernet count/connector not stated (1 RJ45 assumed); front USB type assumed A. Max 170 W; PSU count/inlet not stated (100-240 V 6 A).
IA — non confirmé : typ_w (typical power consumption not published; only max 170 W), psu (number of power supplies not stated in datasheet), power_connector (AC inlet connector type not stated in the datasheet text I could access), port side (front/rear) for each connector group: the datasheet text doesn't say; only the front TFT LCD display is confirmed on the front, location of USB host type A (front or rear) unconfirmed, exact Genlock BNC count (datasheet says 'BNC with loop'; 2 assumed = in + loop), Dante card RJ45 count (primary + secondary per quick start guide, optional card)
